newsitem.title: USA: AOL has over 500,000 international members.
newsitem.headline: AOL has over 500,000 international members.

text.p: America Online Inc said that it exceeded 500,000 members internationally, as it launched local services in the past 14 months in Germany, the U.K., France and Canada.
Since launching AOL Canada in January, AOL said it has become the leading consumer-based Internet online service provider in Canada with over 100,000 members.
AOL Europe, which is a joint venture between America Online and media giant Bertelsmann AG, has just reached 400,000 members, becoming the fastest growing online service in Europe, AOL said.

Future expansion plans for AOL include the launch of AOL in Japan in the spring of 1997, in a partnership with Nihon Keizai Shimbun Inc (Nikkei) and Mitsui & Co Ltd. The joint Japanese venture was announced last May.
In addition to Japan, further expansion into Europe is planned and the company is exploring additional opportunities in Asia and South America.
